---
title: The nightly import, check by check
description: A flow chart lays out cards in the order their edges give, joins them with right-angled lines that never cross a card, and sets each label on free paper beside its line.
version: 0.0.2
styles: [scientific]
---

## Nothing is written until every check passes

The import waits for its files, loads them, then runs its checks inside one job. A failed check or a changed schema stops the run before any table changes, and the alert names the check. Only a clean run refreshes the summaries and, when publishing is on, writes the dashboard's extract.

```chart
type: flow
title: Nothing is written until every check passes
subtitle: The nightly import. A red line is a failure; the dashed line waits and asks again.
nodes:
  - {title: Nightly run starts, kind: start}
  - {id: fresh, title: "New files since the last run?", kind: decision}
  - id: wait
    title: Wait and look again
    lines: |
      every 15 minutes, four times at most;
      then the alert
    tone: muted
  - id: load
    title: Load the new files
    lines: |
      parse CSV and JSON;
      reject rows without an id
  - id: checks
    title: Run the checks
    lines: |
      row counts, ranges, duplicates;
      results kept in run_checks
  - {id: failed, title: "Any check failed?", kind: decision}
  - {id: schema, title: "Schema as yesterday?", kind: decision}
  - id: write
    title: Write the tables
    lines: replace today's partition
  - id: totals
    title: Refresh the summaries
    lines: one row per region and day
  - id: stop
    title: Run fails
    lines: |
      nothing written;
      the alert names the check
    tone: alert
  - {id: publish, title: "Publish on?", kind: decision}
  - id: extract
    title: Dashboard extract
    kind: object
    lines: |
      orders.parquet,
      then _MANIFEST last
  - {id: done, title: Run ends, kind: end}
groups:
  - {label: One job · checks before any write, nodes: [checks, failed, schema, write, totals, stop]}
edges:
  - Nightly run starts -> fresh
  - "fresh -> load: yes"
  - "fresh -> wait: no"
  - "wait ..> fresh: look again"
  - "load -> checks: new rows"
  - checks -> failed
  - "failed -> schema: no"
  - {edge: "failed -> stop: yes", tone: alert}
  - "schema -> write: yes"
  - {edge: "schema -> stop: no", tone: alert}
  - write -> totals
  - totals -> publish
  - "publish -> extract: yes"
  - "publish -> done: no"
  - extract -> done
```

*Source: Illustrative pipeline.*

Move through the cards with the keyboard in reading order; each one names what leads to it and where it leads.
